alexcrichton opened PR #14727 from alexcrichton:fix-path-with-query to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit updates the handling of the set-path-with-query WIT function in WASIp{2,3} to require that the path specified starts with /, ?, or is empty. This isn't checked by the http crate for us, so it needs to be manually done in Wasmtime.
